item.meaning: Arabic word meaning 'season', from which the word 'monsoon' is derived.

item.definition: The long-term average pattern of weather conditions observed over a large region over decades (typically 30+ years).

item.concept_name: Thermal Pressure Gradient and Monsoon Mechanism
item.description: Differential heating between the hot Indian landmass (low pressure) and cooler Indian Ocean (high pressure) draws moisture-laden summer monsoon winds.
